headline: RBI Reports NBFC Credit Growth Rises 15.4% Year-on-Year in September
summary: Data released by the Reserve Bank of India showed that credit deployment by non-banking financial companies and housing finance companies grew by 15.4% year-on-year in September 2026, compared to 13.3% a year earlier.
why: NBFC credit growth figures indicate lending momentum in India's shadow banking sector and broader economic liquidity.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Accelerated non-bank credit growth reflects robust domestic financing activity.
